theme: 3 terms on how Swift picks the method to run: known at build time, chosen while running, and the table behind protocols

terms.definition: A method call whose exact code the compiler already knows when it builds the app.
terms.example: Struct methods use Static Dispatch, so the call is very fast.

terms.definition: A method call that picks which code to run while the app is running, based on the object's real type.
terms.example: Dynamic Dispatch is why the `Cat` version ran, not the `Animal` one.

terms.definition: A hidden table Swift uses to find a type's protocol methods while the app is running.
terms.example: Calls through `any Speaker` go through the Witness Table.

video.title: Static Dispatch, Dynamic Dispatch & Witness Table | Day 56
video.description:
Learn to explain how Swift picks which method to run: Static Dispatch, Dynamic Dispatch & Witness Table, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Static Dispatch - A method call whose exact code the compiler already knows when it builds the app.
Dynamic Dispatch - A method call that picks which code to run while the app is running, based on the object's real type.
Witness Table - A hidden table Swift uses to find a type's protocol methods while the app is running.

landscape.title: Swift Static Dispatch, Dynamic Dispatch & Witness Table | Day 56
landscape.description:
Explain Static Dispatch, Dynamic Dispatch & Witness Table in Swift by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
정적 디스패치, 동적 디스패치, 위트니스 테이블 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Static Dispatch - A method call whose exact code the compiler already knows when it builds the app.
한국어: 정적 디스패치: 앱을 빌드할 때 컴파일러가 실행할 코드를 이미 정확히 아는 메서드 호출

Dynamic Dispatch - A method call that picks which code to run while the app is running, based on the object's real type.
한국어: 동적 디스패치: 앱이 실행되는 동안 객체의 실제 타입에 따라 실행할 코드를 고르는 메서드 호출

Witness Table - A hidden table Swift uses to find a type's protocol methods while the app is running.
한국어: 위트니스 테이블: 앱 실행 중 타입의 프로토콜 메서드를 찾기 위해 Swift가 쓰는 숨은 표

In this video, Mina and Jake sort out why a call printed the subclass version, which calls are fastest and how protocol calls find their method, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: Can you explain method dispatch in English?

dialogue.title: Why did badge print?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, `v` is a `View`, but `draw()` printed badge. How?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's Dynamic Dispatch. Swift checks the real type while the app runs.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A little. Each call looks up the right method first.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Structs use Static Dispatch. The compiler knows the exact method ahead of time.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Nothing can override it, so calls on a `Badge` can use Static Dispatch.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then Swift uses a Witness Table. It lists each type's protocol methods.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So a Witness Table is like Dynamic Dispatch for protocols?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. Static Dispatch is fastest, and the other two pick at runtime.
Static Dispatch: the compiler knows the method ahead of time.
